status_code_data.description: The HTTP 404 Not Found client error response status code indicates that the server cannot find the requested resource. A 404 status code only indicates that the resource is missing without indicating if this is temporary or permanent.

meme_data.description: Nileseyy Niles Disappears is a photo series based on a Vine video by the comedian Nileseyy Niles (real name: Niles Stewart). The photo series is often used on Black Twitter to indicate someone leaving an embarrassing situation.
